summary: Initialize derived parameter property only after super establishes this.

source.pattern: class D extends B { constructor(public x:T){ super(); $body } }

target.notes: Model observable JavaScript emitted by TypeScript first, then reuse canonical JS class/module/object semantics.

tests.name: derived
tests.input: class B{}; class D extends B { constructor(public x:number){ super(); console.log(this.x) } }; new D(2);

tests.name: own property
tests.input: class B{}; class D extends B { constructor(public x:number){ super() } }; console.log(Object.hasOwn(new D(1),'x'));
